name: smwgraphics-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-tournament-fighters-genesis-bio-planet
title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (Genesis) - Bio Planet
description:
Tileset was ripped by Belial. I converted it for SMW usage. I mirrored it for efficiency and tile reduction.

This does have some advantages:

-The BG consumes half of palette 1 and the FG consumes half of palette 4 and both palettes are organised. The SMW status colors aren't affected.
-The BG uses 33 tiles, making this a short one. The FG uses a full Map16 page. Check the sample file to see the setup.
-The BG's colors are animated. I did this quite well.

Credit Belial for the tileset.
